title: subdivision
body:
## subdivision

Subdivides a copy of the input mesh with Blender's Subdivision Surface modifier; Schemaxis sets the same level for viewport and render evaluation, so images, saved scenes and STL publications agree. CATMULL_CLARK smooths and rounds the shape; SIMPLE only adds vertices and keeps the shape, which is the usual preparation for bend, twist, shrinkwrap or smooth.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Each level multiplies the face count by about four; level 4 on a detailed import can be very large.
- CATMULL_CLARK shrinks sharp shapes such as a cube towards a rounded blob; add bevel first or use SIMPLE.

Native binding: `subdivision`. Output kind: `["data"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | one node | yes | `data` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `levels` | Number of subdivision passes, applied to both viewport and render evaluation. Each level splits every quad into four; 0 leaves the mesh unchanged. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":4}` | `1` |
| `method` | Subdivision algorithm. CATMULL_CLARK moves vertices to approximate a smooth limit surface, rounding corners and shrinking sharp shapes; choose it for organic or rounded results. SIMPLE only inserts vertices without changing the shape; choose it to add resolution before bend, twist, shrinkwrap or smooth. | `{"type":"enum","values":["CATMULL_CLARK","SIMPLE"]}` | `"CATMULL_CLARK"` |
